name: New Assignment Notification (Student)
description: Sent to every student enrolled in a module when their instructor posts a new assignment in that module.
subject: New Assignment in $module_code: $assignment_title
body_text:
Dear $first_name,

A new assignment has been posted for $module_code ($module_name):

- Assignment: $assignment_title
- Due date: $due_date
- Max marks: $max_marks
- Type: $assignment_type
- Late submissions: $late_submission_policy

Description
-----------
$description

You can submit your work through the Assignments portal in the University System. Your final submission will be scanned automatically for plagiarism once you upload it.

$signature
